# jumpcloud_software_app_association (Resource)

Associates a JumpCloud software application with a system or system group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_software_app_association" "chrome_to_all_systems" {
  software_app_id = jumpcloud_software_app.chrome.id
  target_type     = "system_group"
  target_id       = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `software_app_id` (String) The ID of the software application.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the target system or system group.
- `target_type` (String) The type of target: system or system_group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format software_app_id/target_type/target_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_software_app_association.example <software-app-id>/<target-type>/<target-id>
```
